message.content:
(1) **What is visible:** The "Why Choose Us" section displays a large headline and a 2x3 grid of feature cards (e.g., "BIS Licensed Manufacturing," "Independent Lab Testing") with icons, titles, and descriptive body text on an off-white background. A floating navigation bar and contact widgets overlap the bottom portion.

(2) **Visual Quality:** **7/10** – Clean layout with good hierarchy and professional iconography, though the floating UI elements create visual clutter.

(3) **Top Improvements:** 
- **Increase body text contrast:** Change the card description color from light grey (#666 or similar) to dark charcoal (#333 or #1f2937) to meet WCAG AA standards for readability against white backgrounds.
- **Remove floating obstruction:** Relocate or hide the overlapping "On this page" navigation bar that obscures the bottom row of content cards.

(4) **Production-ready:** **No** – Body text contrast is insufficient for accessibility compliance, and the floating navigation creates a critical readability issue by covering content.
